criteria.title: Proposed: foundation model and permissions
criteria.startingState: Proposed. Documentation exists; target org metadata, picklists, permissions, and existing-data impact are unverified. Implementation and acceptance are NOT RUN.
actions: Inspect supported Shipment-to-order linkage on the target org.
Inspect requested provider and status picklists, unique case-insensitive External_Tracking_Id__c Text 255, safe tracking link, and permissions, including existing-data impact.
Record any Order-only fallback and whether it is proven.
criteria.expectedResult: Supported linkage, fields, unique external id, safe link, and permissions are verified, including existing-data impact. Any Order-only fallback is proven. NOT RUN.

criteria.title: Proposed: Job A dispatch upserts
criteria.startingState: Proposed. Job A is documented to run at 07:00 and 19:00. Timezone is conflicting in the sources. Implementation is NOT RUN.
actions: Run or simulate Job A against staged ERP changes, including a replay of already processed packages.
Confirm each change resolves to exactly one parent and upserts in collections of at most 200.
Inspect failed rows for recoverability and confirm replay creates no duplicate packages.
criteria.expectedResult: Job A pages and stages ERP changes, resolves exactly one parent, upserts in collections of at most 200, never duplicates packages on replay, and leaves failures recoverable. NOT RUN.

criteria.title: Proposed: Job B carrier updates
criteria.startingState: Proposed. Job B is documented to run at 07:15 and 19:15. Approved carrier mappings and a Delivered-event correction policy are still open. Implementation is NOT RUN.
actions: Run or simulate Job B against approved carriers, including an older transit scan after a newer Delivered event.
Confirm approved mappings are applied and changed shipments update in collections of at most 200.
Record whether a reliable delivery time is stored and whether a correction policy exists.
criteria.expectedResult: Job B polls approved carriers, applies approved mappings, updates changed shipments in collections of at most 200, and records a reliable delivery time. Older transit scans do not overwrite newer Delivered events. Correction policy still needs a decision. NOT RUN.

criteria.title: Proposed: five-request efficiency target
criteria.startingState: Proposed. The user requires no more than five Salesforce REST requests per run for up to 800 active shipments: one query plus four update chunks. The target is unresolved and is not waived. Implementation is NOT RUN.
actions: Count actual Salesforce REST requests for a run of up to 800 active shipments, including pagination, authentication, retries, and parent resolution.
Compare the count with the five-request target and record any exception policy.
criteria.expectedResult: Actual request counts are measured. Accounting and any exception policy are resolved without silently waiving the five-request target. NOT RUN.

criteria.title: Proposed: failed SaveResult operations
criteria.startingState: Proposed. Alert destination is unset. Implementation is NOT RUN.
actions: Force or simulate a failed SaveResult inside an HTTP 200 collection response.
Inspect retained record id, protected payload or reference, status code, and message.
Confirm a summary is sent to the selected Slack, email, Linear, or Sentry destination, and that retries, uncertain commits, and quarantined records can be recovered and reconciled.
criteria.expectedResult: Each failed SaveResult retains record id, protected payload or reference, status code, and message. A summary reaches the selected destination. Retries, uncertain commits, and quarantined records are recoverable, and source and destination can be reconciled. NOT RUN.

criteria.title: Proposed: buyer-visible shipment details
criteria.startingState: Proposed. Standard UI support for package-level data is unverified. Implementation and acceptance are NOT RUN.
actions: Desktop UI: open order details as an authorized buyer and as a buyer from another account.
Confirm each correct shipment, carrier, tracking, status, and dates, with a safe link and truthful empty or stale states.
Prove the standard UI can present package-level data before selecting it, and confirm cross-account isolation.
criteria.expectedResult: Authorized buyers see each correct shipment, carrier, tracking, status, and dates, with a safe link and truthful empty or stale states. Cross-account isolation holds. Standard UI support for package-level data is proven before it is selected. NOT RUN.

criteria.title: Proposed: security and evidence
criteria.startingState: Proposed. Independent checker and human acceptance owner are Pending. Implementation and acceptance are NOT RUN.
actions: Test least privilege, secret handling, multiple packages, replay, out-of-order events, failures, and access isolation.
Record independent verification separately from human acceptance.
criteria.expectedResult: Least privilege, secrets, multiple packages, replay, out-of-order events, failures, and access isolation are tested with evidence. Independent verification and human acceptance remain pending. NOT RUN.

criteria.title: Proposed: reusable checkout without secrets
criteria.startingState: Proposed. Added after revision 0.1. A local POC build plan exists. No working integration was observed in this transfer. NOT RUN.
actions: From a clean checkout, follow the documented setup using only permitted synthetic configuration.
Inspect configuration and staged content for real environment values.
criteria.expectedResult: Configurable jobs can be set up without real environment values in committed files. Configuration and staged content confirm that result. NOT RUN.
